desktop_prompt:
Generate ONE complete long DESKTOP website screen at 1280px wide as a faithful visual study of the CURRENT publicly visible Tesla US homepage https://www.tesla.com/ observed 2026-09-28. Render actual screen and HTML. Use the specific 2026 public page, not an imagined futuristic car landing page.
FIRST 1280×720 VIEWPORT: white 56px nav with black spaced TESLA lettering at x48, center labels Vehicles, Energy, Charging, Semi, Discover, Shop; right small outline help, globe and account icons. Below, 516px edge-to-edge photographic hero carousel, starting y56 and ending y572. First slide photo: THREE current white/red/silver Tesla cars driving toward camera/side on road beside Chicago skyline and water, blue sky with city towers; the cars occupy middle/lower half. White centered 48px title "Model Y" at y114, white underlined "1.49% APR Available" at y170, two 200×40 rectangular CTAs at y216: Tesla electric blue #3e6ae1 "Order Now" and white "Learn More". White square arrow controls left/right at y335, three tiny dots center near hero bottom. Under hero there is white 48px gap, then top of light-gray FSD card visible at viewport bottom. A sticky thin bottom dock overlays page: gray "Ask a Question" field and "Schedule a Drive Today" button. No generic top announcement bar.
FULL CURRENT PAGE ORDER: after hero a wide 2-column Full Self-Driving (Supervised) module on light gray: large black title, "Makes every drive easier. Subscribe for $99/mo." note, two large metrics "7x Fewer Collisions" and a changing miles-driven number, black Schedule Demo and white Learn More; right actual in-car driving video. Next a horizontal carousel of FIVE giant photographic vehicle cards, first Model Y L Premium, then Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck, Certified Pre-Owned; first card says "Long Wheelbase Midsize SUV / Model Y L Premium / Starting at $61,990", blue Order Now and white Learn More; neighboring next card clipped at right; dot navigation. Next two side-by-side 50/50 pale gray promo panels with image crops: "Current Offers" with three car image and "Inventory" with parked cars aerial photo; white buttons. Next wide map of US/Canada filled with red charging dots, "Find Your Charge", subtitle "View the network of Tesla Superchargers and Destination Chargers available near you", black View Network / gray Learn More, and prominent charge counts. Next horizontal energy carousel with giant photograph of glossy black Solar Panels on roof, clipped Powerwall card at right, three dots; panels Solar Panels, Powerwall, Megapack with white title and blue/white actions. End with tiny legal offer footnotes and understated one-line Tesla footer links.
Visual rules: documentary automotive photography fills large cards; no gradients or abstract shapes added by designer; white blank space between sections, light gray card surfaces #f4f4f4, black #171a20 Universal Sans-like typography, medium weight, 4px buttons, only accent #3e6ae1. Match desktop section heights (hero 516px, FSD 448px, vehicle gallery 664px, promos 268px, charging 894px, energy 664px) and total ~3789px. US offers/price/counts are only a dated static visual reference, not live offers. Do not invent other vehicles or metrics. The design gallery is free; official purchase actions remain links to Tesla.
mobile_prompt:
Generate ONE complete long MOBILE website screen at 390px wide as a faithful visual study of the CURRENT publicly visible Tesla US homepage https://www.tesla.com/ observed 2026-09-28. Render actual screen and HTML. Use the specific public page and Tesla's restrained visual language, not a generic auto concept.

FIRST 390×844 VIEWPORT: page starts with a full-bleed edge-to-edge portrait photograph of three current Tesla vehicles driving beside a Chicago city skyline, blue sky, wet/dark road. Hero image occupies approximately 700px height and the cars sit in the middle/lower half. Overlay at top: white TESLA spaced wordmark at x24/y26, and a light-gray rectangular "Menu" button at the far right, no desktop nav links. Centered white "Model Y" at about y65, white underlined "1.49% APR Available" below. Put two side-by-side 168px-wide 40px-high CTAs near the lower third: Tesla blue #3e6ae1 "Order Now" and white "Learn More". Three carousel dots at bottom. Very thin fixed bottom sticky bar: gray "Ask a Question" and white "Schedule a Drive Today" with black text.

FULL PAGE BELOW: white/light gray, dense photographic and merchandising hierarchy from the real homepage. Below hero: a Full Self-Driving (Supervised) section with black heading, copy "Makes every drive easier. Subscribe for $99/mo.", two dark buttons "Schedule Demo" and "Learn More", large cinematic in-car driving image/video still. Then a swipeable horizontal vehicle gallery with large rounded image cards, first "Model Y L Premium" and "Starting at $61,990", then Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck and Certified Pre-Owned; cards have title/price and blue or black order/explore buttons. Below that two stacked pale gray promo cards "Current Offers" and "Inventory". Then a Supercharger section with US map and many red charging dots, heading "Find Your Charge", an explanatory short line, black "View Network" and pale "Learn More" buttons. At bottom horizontal energy cards led by roof-photo "Solar Panels", then "Powerwall", "Megapack", with short simple footer navigation and small legal text.

Use Tesla Universal Sans-like clean sans, white backgrounds, #171a20 black text, #3e6ae1 blue primary, square/slightly rounded controls, generous whitespace. Preserve the mobile page's natural scroll composition and genuine official marketing photos. No editorial showcase framing, fake device, gradients, pricing table, or fabricated sections.
